title: AI-assisted model: open and closed circuits
explanation: Original AI-assisted animation with on-screen captions. A complete conducting path allows current in this simplified low-voltage model. With 6 V across 100 ohms, I = V/R = 0.06 A (60 mA). Observe the switch, then compare voltage and resistance in the virtual workbench. Teacher review required; this is not recorded laboratory footage. No mains electricity.

title: AI-assisted model: microscope magnification
explanation: Original AI-assisted diagram animation with on-screen captions. Total magnification equals eyepiece magnification multiplied by objective magnification. A 10x eyepiece and 4x objective give 40x; a 10x objective gives 100x. Increasing magnification shows a smaller field of view in this schematic. The cell drawings are illustrative, not calibrated microscopy images. Teacher review required.

title: AI-assisted model: measuring average speed
explanation: Original AI-assisted measurement animation with on-screen captions. A model object covers 20 m in 5 s, so average speed is total distance divided by total time: 4 m/s. Average speed does not describe every instant of a journey. Record units and discuss timing uncertainty in real measurements. Teacher review required; the animation is a model rather than experimental evidence.
